text_block_list.text:
Tryouts—where Umamusume of all
backgrounds meet their destined
trainers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I stop by a nearby shrine to make a quick
wish in hopes of meeting
the absolute best
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa! Do my eyes deceive me, or is
that shining emblem what I
think it is?!

So the fated day has finally arrived! My
trainer has appeared before
me!
choice_data_list: If it's money you're after, I don't have any.

text_block_list.text:
Waaah?! Just who do you think I am?! I'm
an upstanding Umamusume!
I'd never do
something so nefarious!

Oh, right. I haven't introduced myself.
Sorry about that! Call me

Matikanefukukitaru!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I've been waitin' and waitin' for the One to show up. Finally! All that waiting has paid off!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: The One? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about none other than you, of
course!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
A mere few hours ago, the great Shiraoki
revealed to me that I must
come to this
shrine and try my luck by drawing a
fortune.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And surprise, surprise—it said I would
"meet the One" at this very
spot!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
That's when you showed up, just like it
said you would!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: I think you've got the wrong person.

text_block_list.text:
H-hooold on, don't you move! I've got the
right person—I know it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Just think about it for a moment! I'm an
Umamusume, and you're a
trainer! Isn't this
too perfect to just be some kind of
coincidence?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Our meeting was fated—predestined to
happen and divined by the
great Shiraoki
herself!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Tis not the time to dawdle! We must rise
to the challenge and seize
our future by
running in the Twinkle Series—you and me,
together!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
She's really going to make me her trainer if
I don't say anything.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Sorry, but I can't be your trainer without getting
to know you first.

text_block_list.text: Fair enough. That checks out!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Got it! In that case, please hear me out!
There's this event where I can
show you
who I really am!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
At the upcoming tryouts, I'll prove to you
my worth as a runner!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'll make you regret that you didn't scout
me right here and now, just
you wait and
see!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And when you eventually change your
mind, that's when we'll start
training! But
for now, I've gotta hit it! Great fortune
await me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
With that final exclamation, the young girl
by the name of
Matikanefukukitaru dashed
off into the horizon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next day, I make my way to the
racetrack and see all the hopeful

Umamusume deeply focused on training
for the upcoming tryouts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let's give this our best shot! Got it,
Suzuka?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Ummm... Why did you bring me here?
What are we doing at the
racetrack?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Today's carrot divination said that I'd be
lucky during partner running
practice! So
you gotta practice with me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Well... If that's all you're asking for, I
suppose it wouldn't hurt to
help...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Thanks a bunch! I'll give
you a little charm later as a
gift! It makes
you separate all your disposable
chopsticks perfectly
down the middle!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
All righty then... Since today's lucky
number is 39, let's do thirty-nine
laps
around the course!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
What?! You do realize that one lap is two
kilometers, right?
Thirty-nine laps would
be over sixty kilometers...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Not a problem! The lucky number never
lies!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
H-hey! We aren't really doing this, are
we?!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Dang it... Maybe thirty-nine was too much...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I told you so... And running at full speed from the very start definitely didn't help...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But we ran this far precisely because we
set such a high bar! It's all
thanks to
today's lucky number!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: We only ran four laps though...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's move on now! The carrots told
me that swimming is the
best training to do
next, so to the pool we go!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Today's lucky number is 39, so let's swim
across the pool and back
thirty-nine times!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I beg of you... Enough with your lucky
number...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
What a strange—perhaps even
fateful—encounter... Does

Matikanefukukitaru really have what it
takes to prove herself at
tryouts?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
